verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is a service description saying the firm helps founders make tax-efficient entity-structuring choices. That is paid advisory work, not published guidance comparing entity types or jurisdictions such as Delaware C-corp, UK Ltd, GmbH/UG or Indian Pvt Ltd. The Catalyze Knowledge Hub is client-exclusive, and no formation-guidance content from it is evidenced.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm publishes guidance on choosing entity type and jurisdiction of incorporation (Delaware C-corp, UK Ltd, German GmbH/UG, Indian Pvt Ltd) appropriate to my market
